Terms & Conditions

1. Booking & Deposit. A booking is confirmed only after the deposit and rent are received in full. For day-wise stays, the ₹3,500 deposit consists of a ₹500 non-refundable maintenance fee and a ₹3,000 refundable security deposit, returned when the resident leaves the PG (subject to deduction for damages or dues).

2. ID Verification. A valid government ID (Aadhar or PAN) is required to confirm identity before a booking is finalized. Documents are stored securely and used solely for verification.

3. No Refunds. All payments (rent, visit fees, and the ₹500 maintenance portion of the day-wise deposit) are final and non-refundable once confirmed, including in the case of cancellation. The ₹3,000 refundable portion of the day-wise deposit is the only exception, returned as described above.

4. House Rules. Residents agree to abide by HerNest Hub's house rules, including visiting hours, guest policy, and shared-space conduct, as communicated at move-in.

5. Rent. Monthly rent is due in advance on the agreed date each month. Late payments may attract additional charges as per house policy.

6. Changes. HerNest Hub may update these terms from time to time; residents will be notified of material changes.

This is a general draft and not a substitute for a formal rental agreement or legal review.
